record.question: Choose family members of a Government Servant to whom L.T.C is permissible:
options: Two surviving unmarried children wholly dependent on the Government Servant
record.explanation: Defective item: the printed paper (p.2) shows this as a multi-select worth 5 marks with eight options (a)-(h); the bank captured only (a)-(d), dropping (e) Unmarried minor brothers residing with Government Servant, (f) Children taken as wards, (g) Grandson, (h) Parents. Under the LTC rules the permissible 'family' includes the Government servant's wife or husband, two unmarried dependent children (and adopted/ward children), dependent parents and dependent brothers/sisters, and dependent children of a widowed daughter, so both 'wife or husband' and 'two surviving unmarried children wholly dependent' among the supplied options are correct (a judicially separated wife is excluded). With more than one correct supplied option and no unique single answer possible, the item is held; repair requires restoring the printed options (e)-(h) and a multi-answer format.
